name: agent-harness-codex
description: Portable pseudo-command routing and extension integration for a standalone Agent Harness installation

interface.shortDescription: Route short Harness intents through project extensions.
interface.longDescription: Recognizes the generic h:<action> <target> [preset] envelope, resolves project-specific lifecycle semantics from registered Extension Packs, and preserves provider-neutral operation, recovery, and extension boundaries.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use h:<action> <target> [preset] and resolve its meaning from the current project's installed Extension Pack.
